approach.title: Healing Without the Clutter
approach.subtitle: A new paradigm of women's wellness in Honolulu.
approach.p1: No awkward massage tables blocking your view. No overwhelming scents violating hotel policies.
approach.p2: Just pure, unadulterated emotional support and energetic recalibration. We bring the retreat directly to your hotel suite. Through guided breath, deep dialogue, and gentle energy work, we help you shift your baseline in absolute privacy.

packages.title: The Mana Reset Experiences
packages.subtitle: Tailored recalibration delivered to your suite.

packages.awakening_desc: The ultimate burnout recovery. A comprehensive mind-body immersion designed to reset your baseline.
packages.custom_desc: A fully bespoke half-day or full-day healing immersion designed exclusively for your mind and body's absolute reset.
